name: HUSB238 USB Power Delivery Sink
description: The Hynetek HUSB238 ([product page](https://en.hynetek.com/2421.html), [datasheet](https://en.hynetek.com/uploadfiles/site/219/news/b038530d-67c0-4ba0-9269-de0e666cb35b.pdf)) is a USB Power Delivery (PD) controller that works as a sink, for power ratings up to 100 W. It is compatible with PD 3.0 and Type-C 1.4, and it also supports Apple Divider 3, BC1.2 SDP, CDP and DCP sources.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the chip, which is `0x08` on every HUSB238. Defaults to `0x08`.

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) if you are using multiple I²C buses.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: The interval to read the chip status. Defaults to `1s`.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.
